candidate.why: images whose top-2 cosine similarities are this close can flip on rounding alone; they bound how much of a top-1 delta is tie-flipping rather than degradation

reference.why: images whose top-2 cosine similarities are this close can flip on rounding alone; they bound how much of a top-1 delta is tie-flipping rather than degradation

mlperf_gate.rule: MLPerf Inference closed division: >=99% of reference accuracy

interpretation: top1_delta_pp < 0 means the candidate engine classified FEWER of the same images correctly. prediction_disagreements counts images where the two engines picked different classes at all -- it moves even when accuracy happens to cancel out, so it is the more sensitive detector of a numerically drifting graph.
